boot_storage.name: SanDisk USB boot drive
boot_storage.connection: Windows PC for flashing; Raspberry Pi 5 USB port for boot

usb_hardware.name: STM32F4 via ST-LINK programmer
usb_hardware.connection: ST-LINK USB -> Raspberry Pi 5 USB; ST-LINK SWD -> STM32F4
usb_hardware.note: Actual ST-LINK PID depends on programmer model. Adjust after checking lsusb.

usb_hardware.name: Raspberry Pi Pico (RP2040)
usb_hardware.connection: Pico USB -> Raspberry Pi 5 USB (directly or through USB hub)
usb_hardware.note: Pico USB IDs depend on BOOTSEL/application firmware. Blink firmware may not enumerate at all; warn rather than falsely failing verification.

usb_hub.connection: Optional USB hub -> Raspberry Pi 5 USB port; boot drive, ST-LINK and Pico may connect through it
